purpose: Help the signed-in customer check order status, cancel an order that hasn't shipped, and refund small amounts on their own orders.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Get status and items for one order.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that hasn't shipped. The customer confirms in the UI first.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund up to 100 on the customer's own order. The payments API rejects anything larger.
